description: One stock's full Coil read: opportunity 0-100 and board percentile, entry quality and state (READY / SETUP / WAIT / CHASE / FALLING), hold strength, leadership flag, its book's regime and its coil read (coil_score / coil_kind / coil_note). Covers any S&P 500, Nasdaq-100 or macro name; unknown symbols return the valid-symbol directory. Free; data is one market day delayed.
name: get_stock_read
